topic: Calculating metrics for inactive facilities and frames
summary_markdown: The discussion focused on whether calculations are performed for facility and frame assets that have inactive or suspended statuses. It was confirmed that calculations are still run for facilities even if the `is_active` status is set to `false`, although filtering options might be available during data selection. For frames, this functionality (calculating metrics for suspended/demolished assets) has not yet been released and requires further development or configuration adjustments.
decisions: Calculations are currently performed for facilities regardless of the `is_active` status.
